text: insertFolder sorts siblings in reverse and tests the neighboring effective sortOrder before creating room. Inserting after can use target+1 when the next sibling is larger or absent. Inserting before can use target-1 only when target is positive and the previous sibling is smaller or absent. Otherwise existing +2 sibling shifts remain. The moved folder is still assigned userSortOrder, its rows updated and the pane refreshed. A new-folder caller also uses this helper in already ordered groups. Keep stored/effective values and UI ordering separate from physical folder moves or atomic persistence. No drag, row, persistence or test run occurred.
title: Folder insertion skips sibling rewrites when the effective sort order has room
